LogView$new()

Create a log view. See log_view().

Usage

LogView$new(
  max_lines = 1000L,
  timestamps = FALSE,
  auto_scroll = TRUE,
  id = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  style = NULL
)

Arguments

max_lines, timestamps, auto_scroll

See fields.

id, classes, style

See Widget.
